text: {"name":"lll_conn_event_prepare","confidence":"high","docstring":"Advances low-level connection-event timing and countdown state, invoking readiness handling when the countdown expires.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v1":"conn_slot_table_base","v2":"conn_slot_index","v3":"event_state","v4":"conn_slot","v6":"conn_context","v7":"conn_slot_ptr","v8":"event_time","v21":"conn_context_index"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":16,"meaning":"Input parameter block: event-state selector."},{"offset":17,"meaning":"Input parameter block: index of the 140-byte connection-slot record."},{"offset":19,"meaning":"Input parameter block: countdown byte; 0xFF skips decrement and zero triggers readiness or cleanup handling."},{"offset":106,"meaning":"Connection context: flag gating the IRQ-disable path."},{"offset":112,"meaning":"140-byte connection-slot record: scheduling-mode flag; value 1 selects the direct timestamp path."},{"offset":113,"meaning":"140-byte connection-slot record: index into the connection-context array."},{"offset":132,"meaning":"Connection-slot record: flag gating counter adjustment; connection context: timing correction subtracted from event time."}]}
